scope: Scripted manual descriptors on the CC0 intake fixture; not ground truth for recognition.

chapters.title: Imagination
chapters.body: The gentle slope of the head line stands out in this part of the reading. These formations bring imagination into the foreground of Cheiro’s account.

chapters.title: Steady affection
chapters.body: The heart line below your index finger stands out in this part of the reading. Cheiro reads this part of the heart line through the theme of lasting affection.

nativeMatches.text: A slightly sloping Head line is associated with imaginative work; the source makes its expression dependent on hand type.
exceptions: General reading only; sloping lines have different significance with square versus conic/psychic hand types (p87).

nativeMatches.text: A Heart line rising from central Jupiter is associated with steady,idealistic affection.
exceptions: Source uses rise/origin on thumb side; do not confuse it with the little-finger end. Gender/class stereotypes omitted.
